searchText: ok guys, thx for sharing the feedback; i think this discussion is way too important to be buried in a discord thread; can you please copy+paste your feedback here now: https://ethresear.ch/t/formal-verification-of-execution-and-consensus-clients/25894 so we can keep easy track of it It is not if clients will use it, but if fv is going to be good enough and easy to use. It is a lot different if it has potential or it is it is already made (Experiment is a lot different from production). So, when fv gets a lot better and few good examples are made that prove its efficiency, naturally clients will gravitate towards it (Thinking in reverse is not helpful). I agree with you <@429719902363058177> - I think it will become best practice and implicitly expected across the board on its own because of how usable these tools are getting (I posted this on the eth research thread) As <@402080271563751435> mentioned - the specification is really the tricky bit
